project_overview: CCTNS是一个警务案件管理系统，用于案件注册、调查、起诉和搜索，并提供应用配置功能。

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: 管理员，负责系统配置和用户管理

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: 警察，负责案件调查和处理

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: 公民，可以提交案件和查询案件状态

actors.name: HelpDesk
actors.description: 帮助台，负责处理用户提交的缺陷和增强请求

actors.name: Auditor
actors.description: 审计员，负责审查系统审计跟踪

functions.name: UpdateConfiguration
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有管理员权限

functions.name: ConfigureAccess
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有管理员权限

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: 访问控制规则唯一标识

constraints.description: 仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: 仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
constraints.source_text: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

constraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置
constraints.source_text: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

non_functional_requirements.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪
系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
